rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I can feel the voices supporting
Adel-sama and Laura-sama growing
louder by the day.

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Adel-sama has always been popular
because of his character, but his rash
behavior has often stood out...

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0003
rows.name:
It sometimes seemed as if you believed
you had to carry everything alone, so
I made a point of speaking to you...

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0004
rows.name:
And so I remained close by, so that
whatever happened, you would have a
shoulder to lean on if you needed it.

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0005
rows.name:
But ever since Laura-sama received her
knighthood in Iira...

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Ever since then, it seems to me you've
opened your heart a little and learnt
to draw strength from your companions.

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0007
rows.name:
That is Laura-sama for you.
Now I see why Adel-sama
trusted her with Shin-sama.

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0008
rows.name: What's that? Am I rambling again?

rows.label: tlk70000027_05_msg0009
rows.name:
What are you saying!! I haven't even
told you one eightieth of what I want
to say?!
